Name: Gaddi, Son of Susi
Summary: Gaddi, Son of Susi was one of the twelve spies Moses sent from the tribe of Manasseh to search out the land of Canaan.
KeyStory: Gaddi spent forty days spying out Canaan, then joined the ten who brought back a fearful report that turned Israel back into the wilderness.
LifeLesson: Seeing the same land as Caleb, he saw only giants — faith is a choice about what you trust.
